description:
Two-hour painting class with a local Spanish artist. You will be guided step-by-step using acrylic paints to create a piece of artwork. This is a beginner-level class, so there is no experience necessary! Come relax with chill music, a glass of wine, and a welcoming and friendly vibe. At the end, you get to take home your own masterpiece! This session is bilingual in English and Spanish.

INCLUDES

All materials

An apron for the class

UNLIMITED wine or select beverages

Local Spanish tapas
Other things to note
This is a beginner-level class, so there is no experience necessary! Come relax with chill music, a glass of wine, and a welcoming and friendly vibe. You'll get to take home your own masterpiece!
locationDescription: SOHO ART MADRID is a new entertainment art studio located in the historical Vistillas Garden in the center of Madrid, Spain. Our mission is to support and create art by bringing people together to make lasting connections. Our small studio hosts a variety of events, from sip & paint parties to team-building sessions. Looking to host a private party with wine and tapas? We’ve got you covered!

Amazing experience !!!! Many thanks to you both for this incredible afternoon, I left your studio very happy.
Corey makes the best summer reds in all of Madrid ! If I return to Madrid, I would love to repeat the experience

Let me preface this review with I am awful at art. Giving Corey 5 stars would be an understatement. The hospitality alone was worth it. It felt like a small group of friends even though my girlfriend and I had never met anyone there before. Nothing was forced, we were allowed to paint at our own pace (maybe taking a little too long cause of how bad we are at painting) but Corey was so patient with us and helped us make two of the best pieces we will likely ever paint (unless we come back again which we definitely will). If you are on the fence about booking this , do it. You will not regret your decision. Whether or not you like painting this is one of the most enjoyable experiences I have had. I am a 20 year old male who has never touched art since elementary and Corey was still able to guide me enough to be able to complete the painting with just my own ability. The food was amazing and also made the experience so much more memorable. Corey gave us recommendations for everything possible to do in Madrid, with tailored recommendations to our interests. This kind of service deserves more than just a review. Rarely will you find people that go this far to not only teach you a skill but also connect with you and welcome you this genuinely. My girlfriend and I will definitely be back again!
Great experience! Corey was super kind. He helped us pick what to paint, gave us recommendations, and was overall very great. I would definitely come back and do it again!

This was the first paint and sip I have ever done and I definitely think it was an amazing experience. Corey and Miguel were so friendly, full of energy, and helpful. They created a lovely environment for artists of any caliber (including novices like us!) to paint and they taught and assisted as needed. There was also great Spanish salsa, guacamole, nacho chips and lots of other little bites and drinks. Unfortunately we could not stay the entire duration as we had other commitments but we enjoyed our time at the studio.
I went into the session with no real expectations but was pleasantly surprised with it. I felt inspired to paint though I had not done so for many years now. Thanks a lot for everything.

Had a great time visiting the studio with my mom! We got to select different paintings from a book. It was great for all different skill levels. I was able to draw my own painting from a reference picture, but since my mom is a beginner, they drew the outlines of her’s, almost like a coloring book. Corey was super attentive, and gave great advice to my mom for her painting, and great advice to me for teaching ESL and working in Spain! The drinks and tapas were perfect, and we even ended up staying longer than intended because we were so wrapped up in our paintings. We got our photos taken at the end, and I’d say it was overall a wonderful experience. I definitely recommend it!

Absolutely loved everything about our Paint & Sip experience! Our host Corey couldn’t have possibly been anymore welcoming, the drinks and tapas were delicious and the art guidance we received helped us create beautiful paintings that will forever remind us of Corey and Madrid!
One if the best experiences. The team was super friendly and patient. The experience was fun and easy to go along with others
Corey and Miguel are great hosts!! They make you feel at home in their beautiful studio and guide you with patience and care. The drinks, food and whole environment were perfect!
Great and fun experience! Lovely group of people and Corey and Miguel are excellent hosts that accommodate all levels of painters. Would highly recommend!
